envelope.note: Implemented the brief's direct reading: writable literal modes are modes containing w, a, x, or +; default and read-only modes remain allowed. Launcher recognition covers ordinary direct Python and env-Python script execution without adding a general parser. The focused base probe reproduced all concrete misses across the three accepted P2 findings; the post-change probe covered writable variants, both launcher wrappers, head -n with and without tail, and every named allow control. The exact acceptance command passed twice after the change and finally passed 55 plus 6 tests. No tests, corpus, contracts, command, vendor surfaces, or unrelated files were changed; no full suite was run, as prohibited. Git commit failed only because .git is read-only, so the launcher fallback message and commit object are supplied. The 32 P3 entries are required command/evidence records, not additional defects.

commit.subject: hooks: restore bounded guard recognition
commit.body:

detection. Recognize POSIX head limits on grep completeness sweeps.
